summary: Iteration 2 full-stack testing of ANCRID iteration adding object storage uploads, public /@handle creator pages, and Ecosystem SSO handshake. Backend: 39/39 pytest passed (27 regression + 12 new). Public creator API returns full projection for aaron; 404 for unknown handle. File uploads round-trip through Emergent object storage: POST /api/files/upload accepts png (unauth->401, non-image->400, >8MB->400), and GET /api/files/{id} returns image bytes with correct content-type. SSO: GET /api/sso/clients returns the 9 expected modules; POST /api/sso/authorize (ANCRLAB) returns Bearer id_token whose JWT decodes with backend JWT_SECRET and claims iss='ancrid', aud='ANCRLAB', type='sso', handle='aaron', email='aaron@ancr.io', verified=true, valid ancrid; POST /api/sso/verify returns {ok:true, claims} for valid token and 401 for invalid; unauth authorize->401; unknown client_id->400. Signup still returns unique handle & ANCRID number. Frontend: /@aaron renders public-creator-page + public-passport with ANCRID-2026-0001, CPX-8842-INHR and @aaron handle. /app/sso reachable via nav-sso-handshake, renders all 9 sso-client-* cards; clicking sso-authorize-ANCRLAB reveals sso-token-card + sso-token-preview; sso-verify renders sso-verification; grant-0 appears. Settings shows settings-headshot-upload, settings-banner-upload, settings-headshot-upload-input, settings-public-link, settings-copy-link, settings-open-link (points to /@aaron). Overview passport-share pill has passport-copy-link + passport-open-link->/@aaron. Landing shows 'Part of the ANCR Ecosystem' and footer contains a logo image; tagline 'One Identity. Every Experience.' renders (across two lines).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown past ~830 lines with 3 new routers + storage helpers + large seed lists. Recommend extracting seed_data.py, storage.py, and per-router modules for maintainability.
put_object/get_object use blocking requests inside async endpoints (upload_file, serve_file). Under load this will block the event loop. Consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_executor.

serve_file streams full bytes into memory before responding. For large media, stream directly from storage. Also there is no auth check on GET /api/files/{id} — anything uploaded is publicly retrievable by UUID. Acceptable for headshots/banners but should be documented; do not use for private files.

_public_projection unconditionally exposes DEMO_PORTFOLIO/TIMELINE/etc for any creator — real per-user data isn't wired yet so every /@handle shows the same demo body. Fine for MVP but must be replaced before onboarding real creators.
SSO id_token TTL is 5 min and grants collection has no cleanup / no revocation endpoint. Add /api/sso/revoke and TTL index on sso_grants for hygiene.

init_storage() runs on startup but result isn't retried on failure; if the storage API is briefly unavailable at boot, uploads will 502 until process restart. Consider lazy retry inside put_object when _storage_key is None.
PATCH /api/ancrid/identity has no length caps on biography/mission — could allow oversized writes.
seed_data_creation: None. test_iter2.py creates transient signup users test_h_<ts>@ancr.io and uploads one 1x1 PNG per run into MongoDB files + Emergent object storage (not cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest files at /app/backend/tests/: backend_test.py (iter1 regression, 27 tests) and test_iter2.py (12 new tests covering public creator, uploads, SSO). JWT_SECRET is read from /app/backend/.env for token decoding. SSO clients dict has exactly 9 modules. Public creator page is unauthenticated. File upload uses multipart form-data 'file' field. On the frontend, on the SSO page, sso-client-* cards are present on initial load; after clicking sso-authorize-ANCRLAB, sso-token-card appears below (cards remain). Overview passport-share and Settings public-link both link to /@<handle>.
